structuredContent.body:
The policy-validation wrapper delegates to a general shell dispatcher that assembles a command string. This bounded replacement retains #751's fixed argv invocation `t81 policy validate <literal-path> --json`, rejects unsupported operations/options before backend execution, and limits the advertised entry point to syntax/metadata inspection.

**Depends on #793** at `15b6b2b63fe056d68f959d658a351eba603ce6ea`. This PR targets `candidate/pr750-main-explicit-policy`, not main. Integrate #793 first, then refresh/retarget this PR and obtain applicable hosted checks. Original #751 at `b68853335264d0758124a359f705fb5fbb8dfdc3` and its branch remain unchanged; no legacy #747/#750 stack is imported.

Four active files: wrapper, skill documentation, Python harness and UNIX CMake test registration. Wrapper/documentation/harness bytes exactly match pinned #751. CMake adds exactly its ten registration lines while preserving #793's policy-test timeout and #782's repro working directory. No CLI, VM, Axion evaluator, policy model, arithmetic, process capture, golden or existing historical evidence changes.

Fresh native macOS ARM64, Bash 3.2, AppleClang 21, C++23 Release/`-DNDEBUG`:

- Same harness and same fresh real CLI: original wrapper **86 process receipts / 141 failed checks**; candidate **86 / zero**.
- **Fake mode:** 40 wrapper calls: 16 exact-argv backend responses and 24 pre-backend rejections. These establish dispatch behavior, not policy validity.
- **Real-configured mode:** 44 wrapper calls: 20 native validation responses and 24 pre-backend rejections. Native cases cover text/compiled policies, malformed/empty input, compiled-byte rejection, schema/input identity and literal spaces, quotes, metacharacters and option-shaped filenames.
- One missing-backend probe and one successful policy-compilation setup complete the 86 receipts. No unreadable-file probe skipped.
- Negative controls retain 12 persistent-artifact-change cases, including store creation and command-substitution canaries before backend rejection. Candidate has zero fixture-tree changes.
- Registered wrapper, execution-policy (249 processes), repro-hash and process-capture tests: **4/4 passed**. Bash syntax and source whitespace checks pass.

A zero-budget policy is valid metadata; wrapper validation does not install an execution policy or authorize execution. The separately rerun #793 execution matrix preserves that distinction.

[Durable evidence](https://github.com/t81dev/t81-foundation/blob/c17557ffb4ad54a0e299e47e8bdb9dd5bebf8a59/docs/records/audits/2026-11-14-pr751-on-pr793/README.md) contains 29 audit files (469,764 bytes), exact source/binary hashes, commands, all process receipts, negative controls and source comparisons. Implementation commit: `24596a28d5aebe75ebb86edc1f4a97b377953538`; following commit adds evidence only.

Limits: readable-file symlinks remain allowed; checks do not prevent TOCTOU or provide containment, allowlists, resource limits or sandboxing. Trusted PATH/host/shell/environment remain prerequisites. Other wrappers remain unchanged and outside this boundary. Artifact observations cover the fixture tree, not every host effect. Linux Bash and Windows/WSL are not locally qualified. Main-target CI/CodeQL/format filters do not automatically qualify this stacked base; no workflow bypass is added. Raw evidence whitespace is retained.

Prepared and executed by Codex within the shared maintenance effort; not independent review. Draft only: no merge, policy expansion or scientific-gate advancement.
